lines.2: 「Well? What do you think of that girl? Can you recruit her?」
lines.5: 「I have high expectations for you, Tsushima, so do your best.」
lines.6: 「...After she says that, what choice do I have but go?」
lines.12: It looked like she remembered my face. (Though after all that, she'd have to be an idiot not to.)
lines.14: 「...I seem to recall running into you last night as well.」
lines.16: 「You don't seem to like small talk, so I'll throw you a fastball.」
lines.17: 「I want you to join the student council.」
lines.19: She knocked it right back at me.
lines.20: 「After being rejected this bluntly, would a normal person not move on?」
lines.21: 「That's how badly I want you to join, Yashi.」
lines.22: I tried saying it in a slightly sweeter voice.
lines.24: 「There are plenty of other first-years besides me. Please try them instead.」
